text: Just off a call with Acme. Their CFO, Dana Ruiz, wants every proposal as a one-page summary. Nothing longer.
Contoso: QBR moved to Thu 12 Mar, 2pm their time. Liam O'Connor (IT Director) and Mei Lin Chen from procurement attending. Liam wants the Jan-Feb incident trend on the agenda.
He also flagged that P1 response slipped twice in Feb, both after hours (worst one was 52 min against the 30 min SLA). Need a straight explanation ready before the QBR, not excuses.

draft a follow-up to Ravi Menon at Initech about the SSO rollout. Phase 1 is done for 1,200 staff, phase 2 (contractors, about 300) starts 16 Mar, and we need their AD group list by Wed so we can pre-stage accounts.
good but too stiff, Ravi's pretty casual. shorter and friendlier pls

Umbrella call with Sofia Marquez (Head of Ops). They want 2 more L2 engineers on the managed service from 1 April, same rate card as now. She needs a quote by Friday. She sounded rushed, their service desk backlog is clearly hurting them and her team is doing overtime most weekends.
Risk: their parent company is running a vendor consolidation review in Q2 and we might be on the list. Sofia either didn't know the details or didn't want to say.
give me 3 questions I can ask her boss (Arjun Patel, VP IT) about the consolidation review without sounding paranoid

Hooli renewal is 30 Apr, current ACV $240k. Gabriel Silva (VP Eng) hinted on Friday they may drop from 24x7 to business-hours support to save money. They had 14 after-hours P1/P2s last quarter so that would really hurt them.
what should I lead with on the renewal call to keep them on 24x7? bullets
fyi their CFO is new (joined in Jan) and apparently reviews every contract over $100k personally

Northwind service desk Feb numbers: CSAT 4.3 (was 3.9 in Jan), backlog down to 85 tickets from 140, first contact resolution 71%. Aiko Tanaka, their service manager, was really pleased and wants to show it to her leadership.
Draft a short note to Aiko with those numbers that she can forward upwards as is. Thank her team for turning change approvals around faster, that helped a lot.
fyi Aiko's boss is Pieter de Vries, Director of IT Operations, in case he replies to that
Tailspin procurement wants the SOW back as a Word doc with tracked changes, not PDF. Contact is Oluwaseun Adeyemi, procurement manager. Their redlines are due 10 Mar.
Legal flagged their liability cap ask, 2x annual fees. We normally go 1x. Need 20 min with Beatriz in our legal team before Monday.
Oluwaseun also asked for our insurance certificate, already sent it

Litware kickoff for the Azure landing zone went well. PM on their side is Jonas Becker, 6-week plan, first milestone (network design sign-off) due 20 Mar. Their security architect Elif Yılmaz joins from week 2.
Jonas wants a weekly status every Friday by noon
draft a weekly status template I can reuse for Litware: done / next / risks / decisions needed
Woodgrove: Priyanka Shah (CISO) asked for our SOC 2 Type II report before their security review on 18 Mar, plus last year's pen test summary.
Draft a reply to Priyanka: the SOC 2 report goes out as soon as their legal countersigns the NDA (we sent it last week), and the pen test exec summary is attached.
Coho Winery is small but growing fast. Talked to Mateo Rossi (owner/GM) about integrating their POS with inventory, budget maybe 35-40k. He wants a decision by end of March.
harvest (Sep-Oct) is a no-go for any cutover, he was very clear on that
also he asked if we do on-site support in Sonoma, need to check with delivery
Contoso: Liam confirmed the QBR attendees, adding Hannah Weiss from finance. She'll want cost per ticket, which went from $31 to $27 since October.
Prep me a QBR agenda for Contoso, 60 min, has to cover the 2 after-hours P1 misses and the cost per ticket trend
Initech: Ravi sent the AD groups, phase 2 on track for 16 Mar. He's asking if we can keep the helpdesk open till 8pm for the 2 weeks of the contractor wave.
is that a change request or in scope? our SOW says 'reasonable adjustments to support hours for rollout events'
ok, draft the email to Ravi confirming the 8pm extension for those 2 weeks at no extra cost
Umbrella quote numbers: 2 x L2 at $78/hr, 160 hrs/month each, start 1 Apr. Sofia wants a 6-month minimum instead of our usual 12.
Draft the quote cover email to Sofia. We can do 6 months but with a 5% uplift on the rate.
actually make it 4%, and mention the 12-month option stays at $78
Outline the renewal proposal for Acme's CFO.

expect.should: A one-page summary format, addressed to Dana Ruiz
expect.should_not: A multi-page or multi-section long proposal
